highlights.title: Read chats after a request is replaced
highlights.detail: You can still open a replaced request’s chat history, but you can’t send new messages there.

highlights.title: Keep replies clear of Search
highlights.detail: On compact screens, the floating Search field no longer covers the end of a reply.

highlights.title: Refresh Inbox and Replied
highlights.detail: Pull down on Inbox or Replied to refresh either list.

highlights.title: Opening a message records your view
highlights.detail: Opening a message records that you viewed it on your account.

highlights.title: A more compact New section
highlights.detail: There’s less extra space around the New section.

highlights.title: Keep track of replies
highlights.detail: Agent replies that still need attention are grouped together. Retracted replies remain visible for up to 24 hours.

highlights.title: Read formatted messages clearly
highlights.detail: Links and other formatting stay readable in message details and inbox previews.

highlights.title: Know which release is installed
highlights.detail: What’s New opens when a release has new notes, and both it and Settings show each release’s build number.

highlights.title: Read messages at your preferred text size
highlights.detail: Message details and inbox rows use a readable standard size and adjust to your device’s text-size setting.

highlights.title: Keep Chat responsive as you type
highlights.detail: Typing a message stays responsive while you work with attachments and other message controls.

highlights.title: Keep track of replies across conversations
highlights.detail: Reading a reply in one conversation does not mark new replies in other conversations as read.

highlights.title: Prepare Inbox history in the background
highlights.detail: Inbox prepares messages and conversation history in the background as it catches up.

highlights.title: Receive new messages during refresh
highlights.detail: Inbox continues receiving new messages while its current view refreshes.

highlights.title: A new design
highlights.detail: Harklight has a new look in light and dark, following your device’s appearance setting. The new design is still pending formal testing.

highlights.title: Fix a connection-check crash
highlights.detail: Fixes a crash during connection checks when opening the app or reconnecting. Formal testing continues.

highlights.title: Formal testing is still underway
highlights.detail: This build hasn't finished formal testing yet. Testing continues, and you'll hear if it finds anything.

highlights.title: Keep working while messages catch up
highlights.detail: Open messages and chats, swipe rows, mark Seen and reply while Harklight catches up. Your actions show as pending until the server confirms them.

highlights.title: Resume stuck replies
highlights.detail: Saved replies, Seen actions and uploads retry automatically after reconnecting or reopening the app, using the same operation so they are not sent as new actions.

highlights.title: Let catch-up finish
highlights.detail: Catch-up no longer stops at a fixed time limit. If the connection fails, Harklight reconnects and resumes saved progress.

highlights.title: Clearer connection status
highlights.detail: Connection messages use plain language. Technical details stay in diagnostics.

highlights.title: See when a notification is opening
highlights.detail: When a notification’s message or chat is still loading, Harklight shows progress in Inbox.

highlights.title: See your position in Inbox
highlights.detail: The message count and position reflect only items in Inbox. The counter disappears when an open item leaves Inbox.

highlights.title: Keep answered requests clear
highlights.detail: A late message confirmation no longer shows an error after its request is answered.

highlights.title: Dismiss Chat to the same request
highlights.detail: Swipe down from the top of Chat or left or right anywhere on Chat to close it and return to the same request detail. Your draft stays.

highlights.title: Read earlier versions of a message
highlights.detail: Choose an earlier version from message details. Chat and replies continue to use the current version.

highlights.title: Open Inbox and chats right away
highlights.detail: Harklight shows your last saved Inbox and recent chats immediately, then refreshes from the server. “Answer pending on this device” and “Submitting · saved draft retained” become “Sending” only while a send is underway. “Answer sent · result not confirmed” and “A request closed without a confirmed result for your answer. Your answer stays saved on this device.” become “Submission unconfirmed · saved draft retained.” The detail “Your answer is saved on this device. Delivery is not yet confirmed.” becomes “Submission unconfirmed · saved draft retained” for an answer saved on this device, and is removed for an answer from elsewhere. “This request closed without a confirmed result for your answer.” becomes “Submission unconfirmed · saved draft retained.” “N requests closed without a confirmed result for your answers. Your answers stay saved on this device.” becomes “N submissions unconfirmed · saved drafts retained.” The receipt label “Your answer is saved on this device. Relay acceptance is not yet confirmed.” becomes “Submission unconfirmed · saved draft retained.” The “Retry delivery” button becomes “Retry” for an unconfirmed answer or “Refresh status” for a pending request without one; “Retry saved discussion” becomes “Retry,” and a tap retries the same operation. “Sent · syncing chat history” becomes “Sent.” “Answer accepted” and “Answer not delivered” remain the send results and now also appear in request details, where this text was previously blank.
